sources.name: football-data.co.uk
sources.used_for: Premier League team match stats (goals, half-time goals, shots, shots on target, fouls, corners, yellow and red cards) and referees for 2021/22 to 2025/26 and 2026/27 to date
sources.note: E0.csv files for 2021/22 to 2026/27 downloaded on 18 Oct 2026. Every match matched one already-published result (same date and teams) and every score agreed, so each match keeps a single record that now also carries the half-time score, shots, fouls, corners and cards. First-half markets use these recorded half-time scores, never estimates. The site states its data is free; it gives no formal licence.

sources.name: Football Web Pages
sources.used_for: Upcoming fixtures and kick-off times (17 and 24 Oct 2026)
sources.note: Fixture lists may not include every match on a date.

sources.name: footballdream.in (citing the Official FPL injury list, 14 Oct 2026)
sources.note: Surnames only in the source; first names added by PropLab.

sources.name: Wikipedia — 2026–27 club season articles (Premier League)
sources.used_for: Player directory: names, clubs and positions for all 20 Premier League squads
sources.note: Text licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); attribution and link to each club article are shown on the site. Squad tables lag real transfers by days or weeks, so each club shows its own as-of date. Each club was read twice and the readings compared; known stale entries (Marmoush, Grealish, Mudryk, Adarabioyo, Trafford, Anderson) were corrected against news reports.

sources.name: CBS Sports — MLS schedule and scoreboard pages
sources.used_for: MLS 2026 regular-season final scores (435 matches, 21 Feb to 14 Oct 2026) and the 17 Oct 2026 fixtures with kick-off times
sources.note: Only facts are republished (dates, teams, final scores, kick-off times). Every score was read at least twice from separate page reads and accepted only when the readings agreed; four 19 Sep scores where a stale half-time page disagreed were settled by the two agreeing full-time reads. One score not readable on CBS (St. Louis CITY SC 6-2 LA Galaxy, 11 Oct) was taken from the club's match release and the St. Louis Post-Dispatch. Per-team match counts were checked against the Wikipedia 2026 MLS standings (to 10 Oct). Goals only: shots, corners, fouls and cards are not published for MLS yet. Cross-checked on 18 Oct 2026 against American Soccer Analysis: 434 of 435 scores agreed. FC Dallas v Sporting Kansas City (5 Sep 2026) was corrected from 5-3 to 4-3, which ASA, Big D Soccer (with all seven scorers) and Sunflower State Radio all report.

sources.name: openfootball / football.json (public domain, CC0)
sources.used_for: Premier League results 2021/22 to 2025/26 (for head-to-head history) and Premier League fixtures and kick-off times to 30 Nov 2026
sources.note: CC0 public domain: free to republish. All 1,900 results for 2021/22 to 2025/26 agree with football-data.co.uk (same dates, teams and scores); those records now also carry football-data.co.uk team stats. Fixture dates and times can change for TV.

sources.name: Wikipedia — MLS club and 2026 season articles
sources.used_for: MLS player directory: names, clubs and positions for all 30 clubs
sources.note: CC BY-SA 4.0. Each roster read twice; only names in both reads kept. Players listed at two clubs are left out until resolved. Some roster tables are months old (dates shown per club).

sources.name: American Soccer Analysis (ASA)
sources.used_for: MLS player match logs for 2026 (minutes, shots, shots on target, goals, assists); MLS regular-season results 2021 to 2026; MLS team shots and shots on target per match 2021 to 2026
sources.note: Data from the free American Soccer Analysis app and API (app.americansocceranalysis.com). ASA asks users to give proper attribution, which this page does. Team shots are ASA's team totals; team shots on target are the sum of ASA's player rows for that team and match, used only where those player rows add up exactly to ASA's team shot total (true for every 2021-2026 regular-season match). ASA does not publish corners, fouls, cards or half-time scores for teams, nor fouls, tackles, cards, offsides or saves for players, so those MLS markets are shown as unavailable, never as 0. Where a player's goals do not add up to the team score the difference is own goals. Regular-season matches only (no playoffs or cups).

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons (player photos, found via Wikidata)
sources.used_for: Player photos on profiles and in lists
sources.note: Only freely licensed files (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public domain), each with its author and licence shown. A photo is published only when exactly one Wikidata footballer with that exact name has played for the player's club, the file name names the player, and it was not flagged as doubtful (49 blocked, e.g. group or childhood photos; a sample was checked by eye). There are no live photo lookups on the site: every other player shows a neutral silhouette. Photos may be several years old.

sources.name: Premier League match events (17 Oct 2026 onwards)
sources.used_for: Half-time scores and goalscorers with minutes (penalty / own goal marked) for matches not yet in football-data.co.uk
sources.note: Final scores confirmed by two sources (CBS Sports and Football Web Pages); goal minutes and half-time scores from Football Web Pages; each scorer confirmed by a second report (Sky Sports, VAVEL, Yahoo Sports, Chelsea FC, Fulham FC, NBC Sports, ESPN). Only facts are republished. Team statistics for these matches are added from football-data.co.uk once published; until then they show as unavailable. Goalscorers for older matches are not available from the free sources used.

sources.name: football-data.co.uk (La Liga)
sources.used_for: La Liga team match stats 2021/22 to 2026/27 to date: goals, half-time goals, shots, shots on target, fouls committed, corners, yellow and red cards
sources.note: SP1.csv files downloaded 18 Oct 2026, checked season by season (380 matches each for 2021/22 to 2025/26, all with every column filled). The La Liga files carry no referee column, so La Liga referee figures are not shown. No free-kick, tackle or offside columns in any season. Same terms as the Premier League files: free to use, no formal licence; credited on the Data & sources page.

sources.name: openfootball / football.json La Liga 2026/27 (CC0)
sources.used_for: La Liga 2026/27 fixtures and kick-off times (Madrid times converted to UK time)
sources.note: CC0 public domain. Most later rounds have no kick-off time yet; they show TBC until a time is published. Its 2026/27 results were used only to cross-check football-data.co.uk scores.

notes: Premier League player match statistics are not available: no free source licenses them for public display. Premier League profiles show directory information only.
MLS player match logs come from American Soccer Analysis: minutes, shots, shots on target, goals and assists. Fouls, tackles and cards per player are not available from it.
Team statistics are team totals, not individual players.
La Liga: team statistics only. No free source licenses La Liga player match statistics, so La Liga player markets are not offered and La Liga lineups are shown only when verified.
Free kicks awarded, tackles and offsides are not available for any league: none of the sources used publishes them, and they are never derived from fouls or other statistics.
MLS team research covers goals, both teams to score, shots and shots on target. Corners, fouls, cards and half-time scores per MLS match are not published by a free source we can use.
Always check club sources for team news before acting.
